additive_criteria.statement: 全局动量 int h u dx 等于解析闭式 g/2 (h_L^2 - h_R^2) t（相对误差 < 1e-8；波未触边界）
质量加权速度场误差 int|u-u_ex| h dx / int|u_ex| h dx < 5%（n >= 800，两算例）

verdict_qualified_append: G8 note: the UNWEIGHTED velocity norm int|u-u_ex| dx does NOT pass on the dry bed -- 5.0703% at n=800 (>5%), 4.4351% at n=1600, 3.5497% at n=3200, 2.6727% at n=6400, observed order 0.19/0.32/0.41 (approaching the sqrt-law limit 0.5). The error is carried by the wetting-tip sliver (92.1% of the bound at n=6400) where the exact velocity tends to 2 c0 while the solver keeps those cells dry; the depth field on the same grids is first order (0.1542% -> 0.0193%). Do not use this case to certify velocity output below ~3% without a front treatment change.
